sections.text_helper: Section 68.6.17 "SAI data register (SAI_BDR)" in chapter 68 (Serial audio interface (SAI)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 3563.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x40
Reset value: 0x0000 0000
Bits 31:0 DATA[31:0]: Data
A write to this register loads the FIFO provided the FIFO is not full.
A read from this register empties the FIFO if the FIFO is not empty.
